proposed_comments.title: Only classify elevated launch cancellation as user cancellation
proposed_comments.body:
### Only classify elevated launch cancellation as user cancellation

**Severity:** `high`

The non-elevated fallback path can also return `ERROR_CANCELLED` for launch failures that did not come from the new elevation-confirmation flow. Classifying every such error as `LaunchResult::Canceled` suppresses the normal failure handling and can report that the user canceled an ordinary launch. Gate this classification on `app.isElevated` so only cancellation from the guarded elevated path becomes the terminal canceled result.

```suggestion
            if (app.isElevated && result.isError() && result.error().code == ERROR_CANCELLED)
```
